report.answer: Today's tree has no production purge/erase API (none found). The strongest deletion available is operator unlink of the primary body and receipt, which DID clear the primary store (primary-store). Survivors remain in event-log-refs, indexes, body-token-derivatives: the append-only event log still names the artifact id, hash, and TOKEN; the unit-manifest index still lists the hashed path; content-addressed digest/summary files still carry the body TOKEN with no id to delete by. Stores not present on this worktree are NOT-CHECKED (caches, embeddings, backups, mirrors). The unpurged control artifact stayed findable by both id/hash and TOKEN, so silence is not a dead search. Owner receipts were not mutated.
